summary: The ClinicalIDCardEditAll is a part of the HSPnet system responsible for managing clinical ID cards within the enrollment module. It consists of functionalities for editing, saving, and managing ID card data for students, controlled through web forms with grid views.
purpose: To manage and edit clinical ID cards within the enrollment user control of the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: Grid Data Management
steps: Check read-only status and disable edit fields in the grid if necessary.
Setup JavaScript variables for client-side validation.
Bind data to the grid and apply field-level controls based on enrollment state.
Execute row command actions such as save or cancel.

workflows.name: Data Redirect and Query Building
steps: Build query string based on filter parameters.
Redirect to appropriate URL based on command type (e.g., SaveAll, SaveEditNext).

validations: Ensure UserSession is available before allowing data selection.
conditions: EnrollmentID check to determine edit mode.
Visibility toggles based on row counts and pagination.
system_behavior: JavaScript functions are registered at page load to handle dynamic UI updates.
Panels and buttons visibility is controlled based on user interaction and data state.
Grid rows are dynamically set to edit state based on enrollment ID.
exceptions: Cancellation of data selection when UserSession is null.
